example.en: Once a war breaks out, both sides are in the wrong.

example.zh: 剛才我的麥克風沒起作用，不知道為什麼。
example.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.

example.zh: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。
example.en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
